rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when a place or vehicle is packed with people.

example.english: The morning train was packed with people.
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 baan1 dei6 tit3 bik1 baau3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a container or space physically packed full of things.

example.english: The suitcase was packed with clothes.
example.jyutping: go3 gip1 sak1 mun5 saai3 saam1

rows.note: Use this especially when something is packed with an abstract quality or beneficial content, such as goodness or energy.

example.english: This book is packed with positive energy.
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 syu1 cung1 mun5 zing3 nang4 loeng6
